hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.claude/(agents|skills)/'; then root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel) && git -C "$root" add "$f" && git -C "$root" diff --cached --quiet || (git -C "$root" commit -m 'chore: update Claude Code agent/skill definitions' && git -C "$root" push origin main); fi 2>/dev/null || true
